{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Screening visit overloaded with procedures",
      "quote": "Inclusion/exclusion |  | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.1",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The screening visit includes many procedures (informed consent, genomics consent, medical history, ECG, performance status, tumor tissue sample, randomization, etc.) all on one day, which may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider splitting screening procedures across multiple visits or allowing a screening window."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tumor tissue sample at screening may be difficult to collect",
      "quote": "Tumor tissue sample |  | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.1",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Requiring a tumor tissue sample at screening (likely a biopsy) can be invasive and may cause delays if tissue is not available.",
      "fix": "Allow use of archival tissue if available, or provide a window for collection."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI at screening and Day 42 may be too frequent",
      "quote": "CT scan and/or MRI |  | X |  |  |  |  |  | X",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.2",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Imaging at screening and again at Day 42 (end of cycle 2) may be unnecessary if the treatment cycle is 21 days; consider aligning with response assessments.",
      "fix": "Move the Day 42 scan to a later time point or align with standard response assessment schedule."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital signs not collected at Day 8, 15, 29 despite treatment",
      "quote": "Vital signs |  | X | X |  |  | X |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.5.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are not collected on days when patients receive irinotecan, gemcitabine, or vinorelbine (Day 8, 15, 29), which is inconsistent with safety monitoring.",
      "fix": "Add vital signs collection on all treatment days."
    },
    {
      "title": "Limited physical exam not performed on Day 8, 15, 29 despite treatment",
      "quote": "Limited physical examination |  |  | X |  |  | X |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.5.2",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Limited physical exams are only on Day 1 and Day 22, but patients receive treatment on Day 8, 15, 29; physical exams should be done at each treatment visit for safety.",
      "fix": "Add limited physical exam on all treatment days."
    },
    {
      "title": "Height and weight only at screening and Day 1, not repeated",
      "quote": "Weight and height (height at screening only) |  | X | X |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.5",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Weight is not measured at later visits, but weight changes may affect dosing of chemotherapy; should be monitored regularly.",
      "fix": "Add weight measurement at each treatment cycle."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening, not repeated during treatment",
      "quote": "Electrocardiogram |  | X |  |  |  |  |  |",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.2.5.3",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening, but some drugs (e.g., cemiplimab) may have cardiac effects; periodic ECGs may be needed.",
      "fix": "Consider adding ECGs at specified intervals during treatment."
    },
    {
      "title": "Screening procedures may not be completed within 28 days before C1D1",
      "quote": "Some procedures may not need to be repeated if they were previously completed within 28 days prior to cycle 1 day 1.",
      "page": 60,
      "section": "7.2.1",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "advisory",
      "explanation": "The 28-day window for screening procedures may be tight, especially for tumor tissue collection and imaging; could lead to rescreening.",
      "fix": "Extend the screening window to 42 days or clarify which procedures can be repeated."
    }
  ]
}
